decisions.rationale: Semantic collision. Q142 already makes the same powered-lift/VTOL combination of vertical takeoff/landing and airplane-like forward cruise answer-defining.

Distinct explicit fixed-wing motion constraint. Existing questions cover minimum speed, glide, control surfaces and inability to hover for holding, but not the bank-turn requirement instead of lateral translation.
Semantic collision. Q146 already makes loss of control-surface effectiveness in stall answer-defining; the proposed causal wording does not create a materially different solving rule.
Direct collision. Q061 already tests the swashplate mechanism for rotor-disk tilt and rotor-pitch control.
Direct collision. Q068 already tests tail-rotor anti-torque and yaw-control functions.
Direct collision. Q148 already tests increased rotor count as improving failure tolerance and payload under the same motor-performance premise.

Static multirotor configuration proposition is distinct. Q149 tests deliberate imbalance for yaw; C007 tests the normal opposite-rotation pairing required to cancel net reaction torque before any yaw command.
Direct collision. Q149 already makes yaw by breaking clockwise/counter-clockwise reaction-torque balance answer-defining.

Tier B PASS. Existing Q132 and Q322/Q325 concern helicopter ground effect and helicopter takeoff/landing actions. C009 changes aircraft applicability to large multirotor and tests the broader ground-effect envelope and resulting takeoff/hover control demand.
Direct collision. Q063 already tests the loss of vision-sensor-dependent collision avoidance and attitude-stabilization functions at night.

Distinct maintenance-lifecycle gate. Q294 merely includes periodic maintenance as flight-manual content and existing checks are pre/postflight; no canonical item makes elapsed period or cumulative flight time the scheduled-maintenance trigger.
Direct collision. Q070 already tests IMU composition as three-axis gyros plus three-direction accelerometers measuring angular velocity and acceleration.
Direct collision. Q156 already tests barometric, ultrasonic and LiDAR altitude-sensing modalities and their principles.

Semantic collision. Although the candidate mentions the Ah current-times-time definition, the answer is already solvable from Q159's answer-defining proposition that usable capacity varies with discharge current and temperature, so the proposed item does not create enough new practice value.
Direct collision. Q161 already tests brushless-motor maintenance, quietness and long-life characteristics.
Direct collision. Q162 already tests matching CW/CCW propeller shape to motor rotation direction.
Direct collision. Q071 already makes ESC motor-RPM control and resulting lift/thrust adjustment answer-defining.
Direct collision. Q163 already tests the electric-versus-engine tradeoff in vibration/noise and endurance/range.
Direct collision. Q166 already tests use of the balance connector to correct multi-cell LiPo charge imbalance.

Distinct normal-operation radio proposition. Q246 tests abnormal multipath recovery by changing transmitter position/antenna direction; C020 tests the underlying antenna directionality and proactive orientation decision during normal link setup.
